Callout.Name: Head Injury at a Game
Callout.Message: Player knocked out briefly on the pitch.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, confused, coaches holding them down.

Script.Line: I went up for the ball and I do not remember landing.
How long was I out? Nobody will tell me how long.
I want to go back on. I know what you are going to say.

Callout.Patient: What was the score? Did we win?

Lines.Approach: They were out for a second and now they think they are fine. They are not going back on that pitch.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
